1| """Identifier case conversion."""
    2| 
    3| from __future__ import annotations
    4| 
    5| 
    6| def snake_case(text: str) -> str:
    7|     """Convert an identifier or phrase to ``snake_case``.
    8| 
    9|     Spaces, hyphens and underscores separate words, and so does a change from a
   10|     lowercase letter to an uppercase one (``helloWorld`` -> ``hello_world``).
   11|     The result is lowercase, never contains two underscores in a row, and never
   12|     starts or ends with one.
   13| 
   14|     Args:
   15|         text: Input identifier, e.g. ``camelCase``, ``PascalCase`` or
   16|             ``kebab-case``.
   17| 
   18|     Returns:
   19|         The ``snake_case`` form of ``text``.
   20|     """
   21|     pieces: list[str] = []
   22|     for index, char in enumerate(text):
   23|         if char in " -_":
   24|             if pieces and pieces[-1] != "_":
   25|                 pieces.append("_")
   26|             continue
   27|         if char.isupper() and index > 0 and pieces and pieces[-1] != "_":
   28|             pieces.append("_")
   29|         pieces.append(char.lower())
   30|     return "".join(pieces).strip("_")
